question: Seven people, D, E, F, G, H, I and X, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. E sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between E and G when counted from the left of E. Only three people sit between D and H. F sits to the immediate right of I. How many people sit between X and I when counted from the left of I?
solution:
Given: Seven people, D, E, F, G, H, I and X, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

 
• E sits to the immediate right of D.
 
• Only three people sit between E and G when counted from the left of E.
 
• Only three people sit between D and H.
 
• F sits to the immediate right of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a647a92b0cea90797a65081be0cadd2730b3563c7f30944392ab0e1416b8952d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
